items.title: Extend scope_check_save schema with a required signed readManifest field
items.context: Shape: {filesReadFully[], filesTriagedByName[], scanEscalationReason|null}. Validate the shape, include readManifest in the scope-check signature domain (_hash), and reject saves that omit it. Keep the existing anti-self-absolution boundaries (resolutions/OQ stay outside the signature domain) unchanged.
items.userSees: Missing readManifest in scope_check_save is rejected with a clear validation error; valid scope-check evidence shows a signed readManifest field.

happy.desc: A valid scope_check_save payload with filesReadFully, filesTriagedByName, and scanEscalationReason persists normalized readManifest and includes it in the signed scope-check hash.

edge.desc: Empty arrays, triaged-only reads, null scanEscalationReason, and sorted duplicate-free paths normalize deterministically without changing existing OQ/resolution exclusions.

adversarial.desc: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unsafe, or post-hoc edited readManifest fails closed and hash verification changes when only readManifest changes.

items.title: Extend review_pass_set schema with the same required readManifest field
items.context: Same shape and signing treatment as scope-check so REVIEW-phase passes carry read evidence; the ledger must expose the field so runs can be compared over time (trend queries).
items.userSees: Missing readManifest in review_pass_set is rejected; valid review pass evidence displays an inspectable signed readManifest field.

happy.desc: A valid review_pass_set payload persists normalized readManifest and includes it in the review pass integrity/signature domain.

edge.desc: Review passes with triaged-only files, null scanEscalationReason, and deterministic path ordering remain comparable with scope_check_save readManifest records.

adversarial.desc: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unsafe, or tampered readManifest on review_pass_set fails closed and cannot be silently accepted as reviewer prose.

items.title: Update reviewer templates and dispatch prompts to submit readManifest
items.context: scope-plan and REVIEW-phase reviewer templates must instruct submitting the structured field (B-cee5 bounded-contract language already exists in the templates); a missing submission must surface as a gate rejection, not a silent pass.
items.userSees: Reviewer prompts show the required readManifest object shape and explain scanEscalationReason before the reviewer submits evidence.

happy.desc: Scope-plan and REVIEW reviewer prompts include the exact readManifest shape and instructions for filesReadFully, filesTriagedByName, and scanEscalationReason.

edge.desc: Prompt text preserves bounded-scan escalation wording and does not tell reviewers to use memory or playbook output as gate evidence.

adversarial.desc: A reviewer evidence path without readManifest still fails at command validation even if prompt prose is present.

items.title: M2: derive a mechanical per-run read log for decisions/*.md
items.context: Either retain the reviewer's stream-json transcript at dispatch and extract the Read-call list (productize the fa1777b analyze_arm.py approach), or add a PreToolUse Read hook following the .claude/hooks/lattice-scope-pretool.cjs pattern; bind the read-log digest as run evidence.
items.userSees: Reviewer run evidence includes a digest-bound mechanical decisions-doc read log when read events are available.

happy.desc: Synthetic reviewer read-call events for docs/requirements/decisions/*.md normalize into a stable mechanical read log with a deterministic digest.

edge.desc: Non-decisions files, duplicate reads, relative path variants, and triage-only events are handled without polluting the decisions-doc read log.

adversarial.desc: The mechanical read log cannot be forged by changing readManifest alone and digest changes when the mechanical event list changes.

items.title: M2: flag self-report vs mechanical-log mismatch and unrecorded full scans
items.context: A full-content directory read of docs/requirements/decisions/ without a recorded scanEscalationReason is the defined failure signal; a mismatch between readManifest and the mechanical read log files a finding. Recording only — do not block or alter the escalation path itself, and do not make memory/playbook output gate evidence.
items.userSees: Mismatch diagnostics identify readManifest/read-log disagreement or an unrecorded full decisions-doc scan without blocking legitimate escalation.

happy.desc: A matching readManifest and mechanical read log produces no mismatch finding and records the read-log digest as evidence.

edge.desc: A full decisions-doc scan with a non-empty scanEscalationReason is recorded as escalated rather than flagged as unrecorded misuse.

adversarial.desc: Missing self-report entries, extra self-report entries, and full decisions-doc scans without scanEscalationReason are flagged as findings or diagnostics.

items.title: Guard smoke coverage for the readManifest gate and mismatch detector
items.context: Extend packages/main/src/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.ts (from B-cee5) so validate catches regressions: missing readManifest passing a save, and mismatch/unrecorded-full-scan cases going unflagged. Align with the B-04bb validate wiring follow-up.
items.userSees: The focused reviewer scan guard smoke fails on missing readManifest or mismatch regressions and passes on the expected safe cases.

happy.desc: reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke covers valid readManifest, valid mechanical read-log digest, and no-mismatch green cases.

edge.desc: The smoke preserves JSON cleanliness and normal validate wiring when read evidence diagnostics are emitted.

adversarial.desc: The smoke fails if missing readManifest is accepted, mismatch findings are skipped, full scans without scanEscalationReason are ignored, or owner/self-signed reviewer evidence bypasses role separation.

items.title: Record read counts and token usage fields in the reviewer read evidence tuple
items.context: Scope reviewer found a PLAN gap: the story promises every review emits a tuple of files-read-fully, triaged-by-name, tokens, and escalation-reason, but no checklist item covered token/read counts. Add this explicitly to the mechanical read-log evidence surface.
items.userSees: Reviewer read evidence shows "readLog.summary.readCount" and "readLog.summary.tokenCount" (or "tokenCount: null" when unavailable) next to filesReadFully/filesTriagedByName.

happy.desc: Mechanical read-log evidence includes deterministic readCount and tokenCount fields alongside filesReadFully, filesTriagedByName, and scanEscalationReason.

edge.desc: When provider transcript token usage is unavailable, tokenCount is explicitly null/unknown rather than fabricated, while readCount remains deterministic.

adversarial.desc: Changing token/read-count inputs changes the read-log digest, and missing count fields fail the focused smoke.

items.title: Guard reviewer read capture so non-reviewer Read usage is unaffected
items.context: Scope reviewer found a PLAN gap: if the mechanical path uses PreToolUse/hook capture, the story must prove it only affects reviewer read-evidence capture and does not break normal/non-reviewer Read usage. This item makes that safety requirement explicit.
items.userSees: Focused smoke prints "non-reviewer read capture bypass: PASS" and reviewer read evidence still records decisions-doc reads.

happy.desc: Reviewer-lane read capture records decisions-doc read evidence when reviewer context is present.

edge.desc: Non-reviewer or missing-reviewer context bypasses capture safely and does not throw, mutate reviewer evidence, or block ordinary reads.

adversarial.desc: A hook/capture event that looks like a non-reviewer Read cannot produce reviewer gate evidence or a mismatch finding.
